title: A deeper gravity well
hook: Change central mass and predict gravitational-potential magnitude.
misconception: gravitational-potential magnitude stays fixed when central mass doubles.
objective: Apply potential magnitude = GM/r to compare gravitational-potential magnitude when central mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a spherically symmetric source at fixed distance with zero potential at infinity, potential magnitude = GM/r. When central mass doubles, gravitational-potential magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model potential magnitude = GM/r; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a spherically symmetric source at fixed distance with zero potential at infinity, with a nonzero initial result. If central mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on gravitational-potential magnitude?
recall.why: Apply potential magnitude = GM/r under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
